newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises as govt confidence vote looms.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises as govt confidence vote looms.

text.p: The Czech PX50 posted more strong gains on Tuesday with traders predicting a government victory in a Parliamentary confidence motion currently being debated by Parliament.
The PX50 rose by nearly one percent to 506.3 although turnover slumped to around half Monday's levels.
"If the government wins the confidence vote it could send a signal that the government is capable of pushing through the policies it has proposed," said Ondrej Datka of Patria Finance.
In response to a sharp economic slowdown the government has pledged to boost growth and rein in public spending.

Datka said the government, which called the confidence vote itself, was looking to draw a line behind a series of economic problems, such as the depreciation of the Czech crown, and acquire new legitimacy for potentially tough negotiations with unions over public sector pay.
On the PX50, gainers were led by the major issues. SPT Telecom rose 76 crowns to 3,295 and Komercni Banka closed up 80 crowns to 2,080.
